component.name: YarmiplayTV
component.summary: Watch videos in sync with friends

description.p: YarmiplayTV lets you watch videos together with friends, wherever they are. Everyone in a room plays the same video at the same moment: when someone pauses, seeks or starts the next episode, everybody follows.

It works with Syncplay servers, so you can watch with friends who use the Syncplay desktop client, or with others on YarmiplayTV on their TV, phone or computer. Join the free public servers or your own.

ul.li: Play, pause and seek stay in sync for the whole room
Shared playlist: drag to reorder, shuffle, loop, save and load lists
Room chat and a "ready" check before you start
Open files, drop folders on the window, or use "Open with" on a video
Browse and search your Jellyfin and Plex libraries
Finds the room's file in your libraries or folders by itself
Built on mpv: plays almost any format, with styled subtitles and track switching

description.p: No accounts, no ads, no tracking. YarmiplayTV is an independent app, not affiliated with or endorsed by the Syncplay project, Jellyfin or Plex, and it doesn't provide any videos: you watch your own files and media servers.

screenshot.caption: Join a room, or open videos from Jellyfin, Plex or your own folders
The player in a Syncplay room

description.p: Volume control in the player bar: a mute button, a slider and the level. M mutes.
The player controls hide after two seconds unless the mouse is on them; the Hide button and H hide them by hand.
Several Jellyfin and Plex servers at once.
